testcase.name: Scenario: Switch tabs with a floating command panel open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:122:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch tabs with a floating command panel open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected ✔ When the user selects the Annotate tab on the floating ribbon ✔ Then the ribbon displays Geometric Annotation, General Annotation, Notes, Manage, and Tolerance Analysis groups ✔ When the user selects the Notes group ✔ Then an adjacent panel displays Leader Text, General Note, and General Profile Note commands ✔ When the user selects the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the Notes panel closes ✔ And the floating ribbon displays its 3D Model groups again ✔ And the part remains active
